 Advertisement Advertisement Return to Homepage Shreveport Times Are banks, post offices, schools closed today in Louisiana?
 Presley Bo Tyler, Shreveport Times Wed, November 11, 2026 at 10:01 AM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Each year, Veterans Day falls on Nov. 11 and honors all military veterans who have served in the U.S. Armed Forces.
 The Federal holiday is observed nationally today, which means that non-essential government offices will be closed and their employees will have a paid day off.
 Some students may also be let off from school on the holiday , while others may have shorted days or hold regular classes.
 Are banks closed on Veterans Day?
 Most branches of national banks like Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Citi Bank and more, will be closed on Nov. 11.
 Advertisement Advertisement The majority of local banks will be closed as well, since the Federal Reserve observes Veterans Day and most banks rely on the reserve.
 ATMs and online banking services will be available on the holiday, but transactions and deposits may not process until the next business day.
 Are Post Offices closed on Veterans Day? Will the mail run in Louisiana?
 The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) will observe Veterans Day on Wednesday, Nov. 11, meaning all Post Office locations will be closed and mail will not run. Regular mail delivery and retail services will resume on Thursday, Nov. 12, according to the USPS .
 Is UPS open on Veterans Day?
 UPS pickup and delivery services will be available on Veterans Day, Nov. 11, and UPS store locations will be open. Although, UPS Ground Saver and UPS Mail Innovations deliveries will require one additional business days' time in transit because of the USPS Federal holiday.
 About 200 veterans were honored Monday, November 9, 2026 at Wildlight Elementary School in Yulee, Fla. during the school’s Veterans Day Heroes' Walk. [Doug Engle/Florida Times-Union] Is FedEx open on Veterans Day?
 FedEx will be operating on Veterans Day, but with modified services. Modified Services include early on-call pickups, early drop box pickups and drop box closures in some areas. FedEx offices will be open, and so will FedEx Custom Critical and FedEx Logistics.
 Does the trash run on Veterans Day in Louisiana?
 While garbage pickup services vary by city, most cities will not have trash pickup on Veterans Day, as Department of Public Works offices typically observe the holiday. You can find out if trash pickup services will run in your area on the holiday by checking with your local Department of Public Works office.
 Do schools have Veterans Day off in Louisiana?
 Here are the districts in Louisiana that will have no school on Veterans Day, according to Louisiana School Calendar :
